provenance.interpretation: All 95 refinement finalists and 35 unchanged Kodoku pilot finalists are retained. The 40-sample refinement and earlier 20-sample pilot observations remain separate historical experiments, with all 15 floors and both teammate contexts preserved. Refinement anchors are discovery-frozen primaries; the exploratory Nhalia 6/40 observation does not replace its 1/40 primary. Context aliases, equal outcomes and replays are not independent samples. No current-content success, optimum or causal synergy claim.
